dcMetadata.abstract_tsi: Untitled sketch map of Lake Ontario with two inset maps showing Fort Niagara and environs and Fort Cataraqui (also known as Fort Frontenac in present-day Kingston, Ontario) and environs.
dcMetadata.extent_tsi: 1 map :  manuscript pen and ink ;  38 x 46 cm

note_tsim: Shows forts at "NIAGARA", "Toronto", "CHOAGEN" (Oswego, New York - the two forts shown were also later known as Fort Oswego and Fort Ontario, on opposing sides of the river) and Frontenac".
Drawn in black ink. With (later?) additions in brown ink.
Inset at lower left with a map showing Fort Niagara and environs. Sounding depths are given. A scale of lieu is shown (scale approximately 1:60,000?).
Inset at lower right with a map showing the fort at Cataraqui and environs. Includes a scale of lieu (scale approximately 1:55,000?).
Copy at Add Ms 21,686.32. Bound in a volume. Manuscript addition of "32" in pencil in margin at upper right. Laid on archival tissue. Evidence of old folds. Red stamp of British Museum to verso.
